claims: The Catholic Church is the world's largest Christian denomination.
The Catholic Church has over 1.3 billion members.
The Catholic Church consists of the Latin Church and 23 Eastern Catholic Churches.
The Catholic Church teaches salvation through faith and works.
The Catholic Church has major emphases on the Eucharist.
The Catholic Church has major emphases on Mary.
The Catholic Church believes in one God as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
The Catholic Church believes in the real presence of Jesus Christ in the bread and wine.
The Catholic Church believes that the bread and wine become his body and blood.
The Catholic Church is led by the Pope.
The Pope is the successor to Saint Peter.
The Catholic Church is led by bishops.
Bishops uphold teachings from scripture and tradition.
The Catholic Church has a strong emphasis on the sanctity of life from conception to natural death.
The Catholic Church has the four marks of One, Holy, Catholic, and Apostolic.
Catholics receive grace through seven sacraments.
The seven sacraments are Baptism, Confirmation, Eucharist, Penance (Confession), Anointing of the Sick, Holy Orders, and Matrimony.
The Catholic Church includes 23 Eastern Catholic Churches in communion with the Pope.

According to Wikipedia, the Catholic Church faces challenges such as managing rapid growth in the Global South, responding to secularization in North America and Europe, addressing moral and social issues, and upholding its tradition.
The Washington Post notes that the Catholic Church navigates complex ethical issues like artificial intelligence and surveillance.
A YouTube video from Fr. Mike says that Sunday Mass is considered the highest form of worship.
Catholic Charities USA notes that the Catholic Church has a strong tradition of service to the poor, often through organizations like Catholic Charities.
